label: MODELLED
note: MODELLED. Under the stated assumptions (constellation, signal-in-space error, station survey accuracy, correction latency and link quantization, each input labelled in the scenario with its public source or as ILLUSTRATIVE), the model gives these figures. Not a statement about the performance of any real system; not affiliated with or endorsed by any agency; no TRL or heritage claim. Omitted: terrain and horizon masking at the pole, multipath, receiver hardware, growth of the ephemeris error over the correction latency beyond the line-of-sight re-projection.
